svg.aria-label: Conceptual model: a school year has semesters; students join orgs and clubs through memberships; a paid membership issues a receipt and a collection ledger entry; treasurers file fund requests (remittances and resolution requests) that SAS approves into ledger entries; a resolution request funds one activity, SAS sets its amount, and a liquidation with receipt items closes it and returns unspent money; ledger entries move money between cash on hand and saved with SAS.
svg.text: cash on hand · saved with SAS
